description: Annual and monthly property tax for a home, using a state's average effective rate. Also returns how that state ranks nationally and how its rate compares with the national average. For the mechanics behind the number — assessment basis, caps, exemptions, appeal deadlines — use get_state_mortgage_rules.

state.description: Full US state name, for example "Texas".

name: calculate_property_tax

outputSchema.description: Annual and monthly property tax for a home price in one state.

annualPropertyTax.description: Estimated annual property tax, in dollars.

comparedWithNationalAverage.description: Plain-language comparison with the national average.

dataAsOf.description: Date the underlying data refers to.

disclaimer.description: Estimate-only notice that should accompany any figure shown to a person.

effectiveTaxRatePercent.description: State average effective property tax rate, as a percentage.

monthlyPropertyTax.description: Estimated monthly property tax, in dollars.

nationalAverageRatePercent.description: National average rate, as a percentage.

rankHighestToLowest.description: Rank of the state's rate, 1 being highest.

title: Estimate property tax
